# SciELO SA

> > SciELO SA is South Africa's open-access scientific publishing platform providing peer-reviewed scholarly journals and research collections managed by the Academy of Science of South Africa (ASSAf).

SciELO SA (Scientific Electronic Library Online) is part of the larger SciELO network and serves as a critical infrastructure for disseminating South African research globally. The platform maintains rigorous journal evaluation standards and operates under the governance of ASSAf with support from the South African Department of Higher Education and Training.

## Core Platform

- [SciELO SA Homepage](https://scielo.org.za): SciELO SA main entry point providing access to open-access scholarly publishing database and peer-reviewed journals
- [SciELO SA Portal](http://www.scielo.org.za/scielo.php): SciELO SA main portal for peer-reviewed open-access scientific journals in South Africa

## Journal Standards & Evaluation

- [Journal Evaluation Criteria](http://www.scielo.org.za/avaliacao/avaliacao_en.htm): SciELO SA journal evaluation criteria and admission standards for open-access publishing, detailing quality assessment and collection standards

## Organization & Support

- [SciELO SA Team](http://www.scielo.org.za/equipe/equipe_i.htm): SciELO SA team directory and staff contacts under ASSAf management
